words.enDefinition: the official files a university keeps about each student

examples.en: The registrar can update your name in student records after you submit the form.
examples.zh: 提交表格后，注册办可以把你的名字更新到「学籍档案」里。

examples.en: Student records are confidential, so staff will not share them without your consent.
examples.zh: 「学籍档案」是保密的，未经你同意，工作人员不会外传。

words.enDefinition: a grade printout you can generate yourself from the portal

examples.en: Print an unofficial transcript for the scholarship interview this afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午的奖学金面试要用的「非官方成绩单」，自己在系统里打印就行。

examples.en: The advisor reviewed my unofficial transcript before approving my extra courses.
examples.zh: 导师在批准我加选课程前，查看了我的「非官方成绩单」。

words.enDefinition: an official letter proving you are currently enrolled

examples.en: My bank needs an enrollment verification letter to open the student account.
examples.zh: 银行需要「在读证明信」才能给我开学生账户。

examples.en: Download the enrollment verification letter from the portal for your loan paperwork.
examples.zh: 办理贷款文件时，从系统里下载「在读证明信」。

collocations: enrollment verification letter for the bank

words.enDefinition: the unique number that identifies you in university systems

examples.en: Quote your student ID number in every email you send to the registrar.
examples.zh: 给注册办发的每封邮件都要写上你的「学号」。

examples.en: The clerk asked for my student ID number before pulling up my file.
examples.zh: 柜员先要了我的「学号」，才调出我的档案。

words.enDefinition: the photo card that proves you are a student on campus

examples.en: Replace a lost student ID card at the campus services desk for a small fee.
examples.zh: 「学生证」丢了可以去校园服务台补办，要交一点手续费。

examples.en: Your student ID card doubles as your library card and meal card.
examples.zh: 「学生证」同时也是你的图书卡和饭卡。

collocations: replace a lost student ID card

words.enDefinition: the official school email account the university assigns you

examples.en: The registrar only replies to messages sent from your university email address.
examples.zh: 注册办只回复从你的「校园邮箱地址」发去的邮件。

examples.en: Check your university email address daily because official notices go there first.
examples.zh: 每天查看你的「校园邮箱地址」，官方通知都先发到那里。

words.enDefinition: messages the university sends through its official channels

examples.en: All official communication goes to your university email, not your personal one.
examples.zh: 所有「官方通知」都发到校园邮箱，而不是你的私人邮箱。

examples.en: Ignore scholarship offers from random Gmail accounts, since official communication never uses them.
examples.zh: 陌生 Gmail 发来的奖学金邮件别信，「官方通知」绝不会用私人邮箱发送。

words.enDefinition: your current standing at the university, such as active or withdrawn

examples.en: A leave of absence changes your student status to inactive for that term.
examples.zh: 休学后，你该学期的「学籍状态」会变为不活跃。

examples.en: Employers often call the university to verify a graduate's student status and degree.
examples.zh: 雇主常会打电话给学校，核实毕业生的「学籍状态」和学位。

words.enDefinition: the complete history of your grades and courses at a school

examples.en: A failed course stays on your academic record even after you retake it.
examples.zh: 挂过的科会一直留在「学业记录」里，即使重修也一样。

examples.en: Exchange students should ask how their credits will appear on the academic record.
examples.zh: 交换生应该问清学分如何记入「学业记录」。

words.enDefinition: all your terms, courses, and grades listed in one view

examples.en: The registrar pulled up my academic history to check the repeated courses.
examples.zh: 注册办调出我的「学业历程」，核对重修课程。

examples.en: Your academic history page shows every withdrawal and every transfer credit.
examples.zh: 「学业历程」页面会显示所有退课和转学分记录。

words.enDefinition: paper issued by the university that carries authority or a seal

examples.en: Bring an official document like your acceptance letter to prove your enrollment.
examples.zh: 带上录取通知书这类「官方文件」来证明你在读。

examples.en: Photocopies are not accepted; only an official document with the seal counts.
examples.zh: 复印件不行，只有盖章的「官方文件」才有效。

words.enDefinition: a duplicate of a document that the office has verified and stamped

examples.en: The scholarship office wants a certified copy of your transcript, not a scan.
examples.zh: 奖学金办公室要成绩单的「认证副本」，不接受扫描件。

examples.en: Ask the registrar to make a certified copy while you wait at the counter.
examples.zh: 在柜台请注册办当场做一份「认证副本」。

words.enDefinition: a translation of foreign papers done by an approved translator

examples.en: The registrar accepted my certified translation of the Chinese high school report.
examples.zh: 注册办接受了我中文高中成绩单的「认证翻译件」。

examples.en: Foreign diplomas need a certified translation before the office can file them.
examples.zh: 外国文凭要有「认证翻译件」，办公室才能归档。

words.enDefinition: the first version of a paper, not a photocopy or scan

examples.en: Bring the original document; they only scan it and hand it right back.
examples.zh: 带上「原件」，他们只是扫描一下就还给你。

examples.en: The admissions office kept my original document until I confirmed my enrollment.
examples.zh: 在我确认入学之前，招生办一直保留着我的「原件」。

words.enDefinition: details that identify you, such as name, address, and birthdate

examples.en: Update your personal information in the portal after you move apartments.
examples.zh: 搬了公寓后，记得在系统里更新「个人信息」。

examples.en: The office will not release your personal information to family members.
examples.zh: 办公室不会把你的「个人信息」透露给家人。

words.enDefinition: your official name exactly as it appears on identity papers

examples.en: Your diploma will print your legal name, so check it for typos first.
examples.zh: 毕业证上印的是你的「法定姓名」，先检查有没有拼写错误。

examples.en: Use your legal name on forms, even if friends call you by a nickname.
examples.zh: 表格上要填「法定姓名」，哪怕朋友都叫你昵称。

words.enDefinition: the name you choose to be called in class and email

examples.en: Set your preferred name in the portal so professors see it on rosters.
examples.zh: 在系统里设置「常用名」，教授的点名册上就会显示它。

examples.en: The registrar updated my preferred name, but my legal name stays on transcripts.
examples.zh: 注册办更新了我的「常用名」，但成绩单上仍保留法定姓名。

words.enDefinition: the street address where the university sends letters and cards

examples.en: Confirm your mailing address so the diploma does not go to your old flat.
examples.zh: 确认一下「邮寄地址」，免得毕业证寄到旧住址。

examples.en: International students list a local mailing address instead of one back home.
examples.zh: 国际学生填本地的「邮寄地址」，别填国内地址。

words.enDefinition: a formal update telling the school where you now live

examples.en: Submit a change of address form within two weeks of moving.
examples.zh: 搬家后两周内要提交「地址变更」表格。

examples.en: A change of address keeps official letters from going to the wrong place.
examples.zh: 办理「地址变更」能避免官方信件寄错地方。

words.enDefinition: phone and email details the school uses to reach you

examples.en: Check that your contact information is current before finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周之前，确认「联系方式」是否仍然有效。

examples.en: Never leave outdated contact information, or you might miss a probation notice.
examples.zh: 别让「联系方式」过期，否则可能错过学业察看通知。

words.enDefinition: a document such as a passport that shows who you are

examples.en: Bring proof of identity, like your passport, to collect the new ID card.
examples.zh: 领取新学生证时要带护照等「身份证明」。

examples.en: They will not release records without proof of identity and a signature.
examples.zh: 没有「身份证明」和签名，他们不会发放档案。

words.enDefinition: a warning status for students whose grades fall below the minimum

examples.en: He was put on academic probation after his GPA dropped below 2.0.
examples.zh: 他绩点跌破 2.0，被处以「学业察看」。

examples.en: At the probation meeting, the advisor explained how to get off academic probation.
examples.zh: 在察看面谈上，导师讲解了如何解除「学业察看」。

words.enDefinition: an early notice that grades are slipping, given before probation

examples.en: I received an academic warning for skipping too many statistics classes.
examples.zh: 因为统计课缺勤太多，我收到了「学业警告」。

examples.en: An academic warning is not punishment; it is a chance to fix things early.
examples.zh: 「学业警告」不是处分，而是及早补救的机会。

words.enDefinition: the normal status of a student meeting all requirements

examples.en: You must remain in good standing to keep the merit scholarship.
examples.zh: 要保住优秀奖学金，必须保持「良好学籍」。

examples.en: A letter of good standing from the registrar is required for the exchange program.
examples.zh: 参加交换项目需要注册办出具的「良好学籍」证明。

words.enDefinition: a required pause in enrollment after probation fails to raise grades

examples.en: After two probationary terms, he faced academic suspension for one semester.
examples.zh: 察看两个学期后，他被「学业停学」一学期。

examples.en: Academic suspension usually means you cannot enroll anywhere for that term.
examples.zh: 「学业停学」通常意味着该学期不能在任何学校注册。

words.enDefinition: permanent removal from the university for continued academic failure

examples.en: Academic dismissal is rare and usually follows repeated failed semesters.
examples.zh: 「学业开除」很少见，通常发生在连续挂科多个学期之后。

examples.en: She appealed the academic dismissal by showing her medical documents.
examples.zh: 她出示医疗文件，对「学业开除」提出了申诉。

words.enDefinition: the overall grade category that describes how you are doing

examples.en: The registrar's page explains the four levels of academic standing.
examples.zh: 注册办网页解释了「学业状况」的四个等级。

examples.en: Scholarship committees review your academic standing at the end of every semester.
examples.zh: 奖学金委员会每学期末都会审查你的「学业状况」。

words.enDefinition: a semester honor list for students with top grades

examples.en: Making the dean's list requires a term GPA of 3.5 or higher.
examples.zh: 期末绩点达到 3.5 以上才能登上「优秀生名单」。

examples.en: She framed the dean's list letter that her department mailed home.
examples.zh: 她把系里寄到家的「优秀生名单」通知信装裱了起来。

words.enDefinition: a published list of students earning high grades that term

examples.en: The honor roll posts outside the department every fall and spring.
examples.zh: 每年春秋两季，「优秀学生榜」都会张贴在系楼外。

examples.en: His name was on the honor roll for three straight semesters.
examples.zh: 他连续三个学期登上「优秀学生榜」。

words.enDefinition: an invitation-only group for students with outstanding grades

examples.en: The honor society emailed an invitation after my junior-year grades posted.
examples.zh: 大三成绩公布后，「荣誉学会」发来了邀请邮件。

examples.en: Membership in an honor society looks great on a graduate school application.
examples.zh: 加入「荣誉学会」对申请研究生很有加分。

words.enDefinition: an official letter telling you that something must improve

examples.en: The warning letter arrived two weeks before the withdrawal deadline.
examples.zh: 「警告信」在退课截止日前两周寄到。

examples.en: Do not panic when a warning letter comes; read the listed steps first.
examples.zh: 收到「警告信」别慌，先看清信里列出的步骤。

words.enDefinition: an early notice from a professor flagging a struggling student

examples.en: My chemistry professor filed an early alert after I missed two labs.
examples.zh: 缺了两次实验课后，化学教授给我发了「学业预警」。

examples.en: Respond to an early alert quickly, because advisors only have a short window.
examples.zh: 收到「学业预警」要尽快回应，导师的处理窗口很短。

words.enDefinition: formally ask a committee to review and reverse an official decision

examples.en: You can appeal a decision within fifteen days of receiving the letter.
examples.zh: 收到信件后十五天内，你可以「对决定提出申诉」。

examples.en: She decided to appeal the decision after the committee missed her documents.
examples.zh: 委员会漏看了她的材料，于是她决定「提出申诉」。

words.enDefinition: a formal request to review an academic ruling such as dismissal

examples.en: File the academic appeal with the student affairs office by Friday.
examples.zh: 请在周五前向学生事务办公室提交「学业申诉」。

examples.en: Her academic appeal succeeded because the syllabus never stated that policy.
examples.zh: 她的「学业申诉」成功了，因为课程大纲从未写明那条规定。

words.enDefinition: the official steps for challenging a university decision

examples.en: The appeal process starts with a short written statement of your reasons.
examples.zh: 「申诉流程」的第一步是提交一份简短的书面理由说明。

examples.en: Each college publishes its own appeal process on the registrar's website.
examples.zh: 各学院都在注册办网站上公布自己的「申诉流程」。

words.enDefinition: the last day on which an appeal may be submitted

examples.en: The appeal deadline is ten working days after the results are released.
examples.zh: 「申诉截止日期」是成绩公布后的十个工作日。

examples.en: Missing the appeal deadline means the original decision becomes final.
examples.zh: 错过「申诉截止日期」，原决定就生效了。

words.enDefinition: a meeting where a panel listens to both sides of an appeal

examples.en: At the appeal hearing, I brought my hospital note as evidence.
examples.zh: 在「申诉听证会」上，我出示了医院证明作为证据。

examples.en: The appeal hearing usually lasts thirty minutes with a three-member panel.
examples.zh: 「申诉听证会」一般三十分钟，由三人小组主持。

words.enDefinition: the group of staff and faculty that rules on appeals

examples.en: The appeals committee reversed the dismissal after reading her medical report.
examples.zh: 「申诉委员会」读完她的医疗报告后撤销了开除决定。

examples.en: Decisions from the appeals committee are usually final within the college.
examples.zh: 「申诉委员会」的决定在学院内通常是最终裁决。

words.enDefinition: valid reasons accepted as the basis for an appeal

examples.en: Procedural errors and new evidence are common grounds for appeal.
examples.zh: 程序错误和新证据都是常见的「申诉理由」。

examples.en: Personal disagreement with a policy is not grounds for appeal.
examples.zh: 单纯对政策不满，不算「申诉理由」。

words.enDefinition: a neutral officer who helps resolve student conflicts confidentially

examples.en: The ombudsperson listened to my grade dispute when everything else stalled.
examples.zh: 当一切都僵住时，「校园申诉专员」倾听了我对成绩的争议。

examples.en: Talking to the ombudsperson is confidential and does not trigger any discipline.
examples.zh: 与「校园申诉专员」的谈话是保密的，不会引发任何处分。

words.enDefinition: an official written report of a problem, not a casual chat

examples.en: A formal complaint must name the office and describe the dates involved.
examples.zh: 「正式投诉」必须写明所涉部门和相关日期。

examples.en: She filed a formal complaint after the office ignored three emails.
examples.zh: 办公室无视了三封邮件后，她提交了「正式投诉」。

words.enDefinition: officially report a problem to the office that handles it

examples.en: You can file a complaint online, but paper forms are still accepted.
examples.zh: 你可以在线「提交投诉」，纸质表格也仍然受理。

examples.en: File a complaint only after trying to solve it directly with the office.
examples.zh: 先尝试与部门直接沟通解决，无果再「提交投诉」。

collocations: file a complaint with the department

words.enDefinition: pass an unresolved problem to a higher office for action

examples.en: If the front desk cannot help, escalate the issue to the associate registrar.
examples.zh: 如果前台解决不了，就把问题「升级上报」给副主任。

examples.en: Do not hesitate to escalate an issue when deadlines are at stake.
examples.zh: 涉及截止日期时，别犹豫，尽快「将问题升级上报」。

words.enDefinition: a formal request for an exception to an academic rule

examples.en: I filed an academic petition to substitute one required economics course.
examples.zh: 我提交了「学业特批申请」，想用别的课替代一门必修经济课。

examples.en: The academic petition took four weeks, so plan for delays.
examples.zh: 「特批申请」花了四周，要预留时间。

words.enDefinition: a university rule about grades, credits, or enrollment

examples.en: The academic policy allows one course repeat with grade replacement.
examples.zh: 按「学业规定」，一门课可以重修一次并替换成绩。

examples.en: Read the academic policy before disputing a late withdrawal denial.
examples.zh: 在对逾期退课被拒提出异议前，先读一读「学业规定」。

words.enDefinition: an official rule that applies across the whole university

examples.en: University policy requires all appeals in writing, not by phone.
examples.zh: 按「校规」，申诉必须书面提交，不能打电话。

examples.en: Parking fines are handled separately under a different university policy.
examples.zh: 停车罚款按另一项「校规」单独处理。

words.enDefinition: the office that reviews applications and admits new students

examples.en: Email the admissions office about the missing page in your application.
examples.zh: 申请材料缺了一页，发邮件问一下「招生办公室」。

examples.en: The admissions office extends its hours during application deadline week.
examples.zh: 申请截止周，「招生办公室」会延长办公时间。

words.enDefinition: a staff member who reviews applications and answers admission questions

examples.en: The admissions officer suggested retaking the math course before reapplying.
examples.zh: 「招生官」建议先重修数学课再重新申请。

examples.en: Ask the admissions officer which documents still need certified translations.
examples.zh: 问一下「招生官」，哪些材料还需要认证翻译件。

words.enDefinition: the final outcome of an application: admit, deny, or waitlist

examples.en: Transfer applicants receive their admissions decision by the end of May.
examples.zh: 转学申请者五月底前会收到「录取决定」。

examples.en: The admissions decision letter explains exactly how to accept the offer.
examples.zh: 「录取决定」信里会写明接受录取的具体步骤。

words.enDefinition: the official letter confirming that a university accepted you

examples.en: Keep the acceptance letter handy; every office asks for it first.
examples.zh: 把「录取通知书」放在手边，每个办公室都先要看它。

examples.en: My acceptance letter arrived three weeks after the admissions interview.
examples.zh: 面试三周后，我收到了「录取通知书」。

words.enDefinition: starting your program a later term after being accepted

examples.en: The university granted deferred admission so I could start next January.
examples.zh: 学校批准了我的「延期入学」，我可以一月再开始。

examples.en: Deferred admission is common for students completing military service or gap years.
examples.zh: 服兵役或休间隔年的学生常申请「延期入学」。

words.enDefinition: postpone the term you officially begin studying

examples.en: You can defer enrollment once for up to one academic year.
examples.zh: 你可以「延迟入学」一次，最长一年。

examples.en: He chose to defer enrollment after his family situation changed.
examples.zh: 家里情况有变，他选择了「延迟入学」。

words.enDefinition: a year off between school and university, often for travel or work

examples.en: Taking a gap year is easier if you request deferred admission first.
examples.zh: 先申请延期入学，休「间隔年」会更省心。

examples.en: Her gap year of volunteering actually helped her choose a major.
examples.zh: 「间隔年」做志愿者的经历反而帮她选定了专业。

words.enDefinition: a binding US application plan with an earlier answer date

examples.en: Early decision binds you to attend if the university accepts you.
examples.zh: 「约束性提前录取」是有约束力的，一旦录取就必须就读。

examples.en: She applied early decision to her first-choice university in November.
examples.zh: 十一月，她以「提前录取」方式申请了第一志愿大学。

words.enDefinition: the process of returning after suspension, withdrawal, or a long break

examples.en: Readmission after academic suspension usually requires a written improvement plan.
examples.zh: 「学业停学」后重新入学，通常需要一份书面改进计划。

examples.en: Submit the readmission application at least two months before the term.
examples.zh: 至少提前两个月提交「重新入学」申请。

words.enDefinition: a student moving to this university from another college

examples.en: As a transfer student, I had to submit transcripts from two colleges.
examples.zh: 作为「转学生」，我提交了两所学校的成绩单。

examples.en: Transfer students often lose a few credits when they move.
examples.zh: 「转学生」转校时常常损失一些学分。

words.enDefinition: the senior academic officer who oversees colleges and faculty

examples.en: The provost approved extra tutoring funds for students on probation.
examples.zh: 「教务长」批准为察看期学生增设辅导经费。

examples.en: A university-wide email from the provost announced the new grading policy.
examples.zh: 「教务长」的全校邮件公布了新的评分政策。

words.enDefinition: the ceremonial or executive head of a university

examples.en: The chancellor personally signs every degree certificate the university awards.
examples.zh: 每一份学位证书都由「校长」亲笔签署。

examples.en: Students met the chancellor at the annual town hall on the quad.
examples.zh: 学生们在草坪年度见面会上见到了「校长」。

words.enDefinition: the administrator responsible for student life and welfare offices

examples.en: The dean of students handles appeals about conduct and hardship cases.
examples.zh: 「学生事务长」负责处理行为问题和生活困难申诉。

examples.en: Email the dean of students if your scholarship situation changes suddenly.
examples.zh: 奖学金情况突变时，发邮件给「学生事务长」。

words.enDefinition: the administrative office that handles college-level approvals

examples.en: Take the signed form to the dean's office on the third floor.
examples.zh: 把签好字的表格交到三楼的「院长办公室」。

examples.en: The dean's office approved my late withdrawal after reviewing the documents.
examples.zh: 「院长办公室」审阅材料后批准了我的逾期退课。

words.enDefinition: the office employees who process forms and answer questions

examples.en: The administrative staff processed my transcript order within two days.
examples.zh: 「行政人员」两天内就处理了我的成绩单订单。

examples.en: Ask the administrative staff at the counter before you queue twice.
examples.zh: 排两次队之前，先问问柜台的「行政人员」。

words.enDefinition: a staff person who schedules meetings and handles office paperwork

examples.en: The administrative assistant booked my probation meeting for Thursday morning.
examples.zh: 「行政助理」把我的察看面谈安排在周四上午。

examples.en: Email the administrative assistant if the professor does not reply.
examples.zh: 教授不回邮件的话，就联系「行政助理」。

words.enDefinition: the main building where registrar and admin offices are located

examples.en: The administration building is the stone building beside the main gate.
examples.zh: 「行政楼」是正门旁那座石头建筑。

examples.en: Go to the administration building to submit paper forms in person.
examples.zh: 纸质表格要亲自交到「行政楼」。

collocations: second floor of the administration building

words.enDefinition: the academic unit that runs your major's courses

examples.en: Each academic department sets its own petition rules for exceptions.
examples.zh: 每个「院系」都制定自己的特批申请规则。

examples.en: Contact the academic department directly for questions about course substitutions.
examples.zh: 课程替代问题请直接联系相关「院系」。

words.enDefinition: the front office of an academic department where forms start

examples.en: The department office keeps spare add/drop forms behind the counter.
examples.zh: 「系办公室」柜台后面备有加退课表格。

examples.en: Ask the department office which advisor handles petitions this month.
examples.zh: 问问「系办公室」，这个月由哪位导师负责特批申请。

words.enDefinition: the professor who leads an academic department

examples.en: The department chair signed my petition for the closed seminar seat.
examples.zh: 「系主任」在我的研讨课名额特批申请上签了字。

examples.en: Email the department chair only after the instructor and advisor say no.
examples.zh: 只有任课教师和导师都拒绝后，才发邮件给「系主任」。

words.enDefinition: the written rules about acceptable student behavior

examples.en: The code of conduct covers plagiarism as well as campus behavior.
examples.zh: 「行为准则」既涵盖校园行为，也涵盖抄袭问题。

examples.en: Every student agrees to the code of conduct during enrollment.
examples.zh: 每个学生注册入学时都要同意「行为准则」。

words.enDefinition: the office that supports international students with enrollment compliance

examples.en: The international student office checks that your enrollment stays full time.
examples.zh: 「国际学生办公室」会检查你的注册是否保持全日制。

examples.en: Take your enrollment verification letter to the international student office.
examples.zh: 带上「在读证明信」去国际学生办公室。

words.enDefinition: approved time away from the university, usually up to a year

examples.en: Request a leave of absence before the term starts to avoid failing grades.
examples.zh: 想「休学」要在学期开始前申请，以免课程记挂科。

examples.en: Her leave of absence for family reasons was approved within a week.
examples.zh: 她因家事申请的「休学」一周内就批了。

words.enDefinition: stop taking classes for one term without formally withdrawing

examples.en: Many students take a semester off to work and save money.
examples.zh: 很多学生「休一学期」去打工攒钱。

examples.en: If you take a semester off, confirm how it affects your full-time status.
examples.zh: 如果决定「休一学期」，要确认它对全日制身份的影响。

collocations: plan to take a semester off
take a semester off from classes

words.enDefinition: officially restoring a student after dismissal, suspension, or a hold

examples.en: His reinstatement was approved after one semester of documented progress.
examples.zh: 经过一学期有据可查的进步，他的「恢复学籍」申请获批。

examples.en: The reinstatement letter listed the GPA required to stay enrolled.
examples.zh: 「恢复学籍」通知里列出了维持学籍所需的绩点。

words.enDefinition: dropping every course and leaving the university for that term

examples.en: A complete withdrawal after the refund date still costs most of the tuition.
examples.zh: 退款日后办理「整学期退学」，大部分学费仍要照付。

examples.en: Choose a complete withdrawal only when finishing the term is impossible.
examples.zh: 只有实在无法完成学期时，才选择「整学期退学」。

words.enDefinition: leaving the term early for documented health reasons

examples.en: A medical withdrawal needs a doctor's letter, not just an email.
examples.zh: 「因病退学」需要医生的证明信，光发邮件不行。

examples.en: After the surgery, she requested a medical withdrawal for the fall term.
examples.zh: 手术后，她申请了秋季学期的「因病退学」。

words.enDefinition: a student coming back after a break or approved leave

examples.en: Returning students can register earlier because their records are already active.
examples.zh: 「返校学生」的档案已经激活，可以更早注册。

examples.en: The readmission guide walks returning students through each required step.
examples.zh: 重新入学指南逐步引导「返校学生」完成各项手续。

words.enDefinition: sign up again for courses after a break or cancellation

examples.en: You must re-enroll within a year or reapply for admission.
examples.zh: 必须在一年内「重新注册」，否则要重新申请入学。

examples.en: She planned to re-enroll for the spring semester after her internship.
examples.zh: 实习结束后，她打算春季学期「重新注册」。

words.enDefinition: come back to classes when an approved leave ends
acceptedEnVariants: return from a leave of absence

examples.en: Notify the registrar two months before you return from leave.
examples.zh: 「休学返校」前两个月要通知注册办。

examples.en: Students who return from leave keep their original catalog year.
examples.zh: 「休学返校」的学生保留原入学年份的培养方案。

collocations: return from leave in the fall

words.enDefinition: enrollment level, usually twelve credits or more, required of visa students

examples.en: Dropping below twelve credits can cost international students their full-time status.
examples.zh: 国际学生学分低于十二分，可能失去「全日制身份」。

examples.en: Check with the international student office before changing your full-time status.
examples.zh: 调整「全日制身份」之前，先咨询国际学生办公室。

words.enDefinition: a block placed on a student account until an issue is resolved

examples.en: A hold on account blocks transcripts until the library fine is paid.
examples.zh: 「账户受限」期间无法开具成绩单，直到缴清图书馆罚款。

examples.en: Check the portal for a hold on account before registration opens.
examples.zh: 注册开放前，先在系统里查看有没有「账户受限」。

collocations: hold on account for unpaid fees

words.enDefinition: resolve the problem that caused a block so you can register

examples.en: Clear the hold at the service counter before your registration slot.
examples.zh: 注册时段之前，先到服务台「解除账户限制」。

examples.en: It took two emails and one visit to clear the hold.
examples.zh: 发了两封邮件又跑了一趟，才「解除账户限制」。

collocations: clear a hold with the office

words.enDefinition: a mid-term week with no classes, meant for catching up on reading

examples.en: During reading week, the library stays open around the clock.
examples.zh: 「阅读周」期间，图书馆全天开放。

examples.en: Use reading week to outline your term papers, not just to rest.
examples.zh: 「阅读周」要用来拟课程论文提纲，别只顾休息。

words.enDefinition: a short holiday in the middle of the term

examples.en: Registrar offices stay open with shorter hours during the mid-semester break.
examples.zh: 「期中假」期间注册办照常办公，只是缩短了时间。

examples.en: Most students travel home for the mid-semester break in October.
examples.zh: 十月「期中假」，大多数学生回家。

words.enDefinition: the official start and end dates of each term

examples.en: You should always check the term dates before booking flights home.
examples.zh: 订回国机票前，一定要查「学期起止日期」。

examples.en: The term dates page lists every deadline for the year.
examples.zh: 「学期起止日期」页面列出了全年所有截止日。

collocations: term dates for the academic year

words.enDefinition: the full study year from fall enrollment through summer

examples.en: The academic year here runs from late September to June.
examples.zh: 这里的「学年」从九月下旬到六月。

examples.en: Most scholarships cover one academic year and require yearly renewal.
examples.zh: 多数奖学金覆盖一个「学年」，需要逐年续期。

words.enDefinition: a day the whole university closes, apart from public holidays

examples.en: The counter is closed on every university holiday, so plan visits carefully.
examples.zh: 每个「学校假期」柜台都关门，办事要规划好。

examples.en: Deadlines never fall on a university holiday; they move to the next day.
examples.zh: 截止日期不会落在「学校假期」，会顺延到下一个工作日。

words.enDefinition: the one-week March holiday in the middle of spring term

examples.en: Offices run limited hours during spring break, so submit forms early.
examples.zh: 「春假」期间办公时间缩短，表格要尽早交。

examples.en: She spent spring break at the library finishing her lab report.
examples.zh: 「春假」她泡在图书馆赶实验报告。

words.enDefinition: the long holiday between the spring and fall semesters

examples.en: On-campus jobs post their openings for summer break in April.
examples.zh: 校内岗位四月就会发布「暑假」招聘。

examples.en: Use summer break to retake the course you failed in spring.
examples.zh: 「暑假」可以重修春季挂掉的课程。

words.enDefinition: the last date to settle required fees without a penalty

examples.en: Missing the fee deadline puts a hold on your registration.
examples.zh: 错过「缴费截止日期」，注册会被加上限制。

examples.en: The fee deadline for spring is posted on the important dates page.
examples.zh: 春季「缴费截止日期」公布在重要日期页面上。

words.enDefinition: the final date to submit an application for a program

examples.en: The application deadline for readmission is the first of March.
examples.zh: 重新入学的「申请截止日期」是三月一日。

examples.en: Set a phone reminder a month before each application deadline.
examples.zh: 在每个「申请截止日期」前一个月设个手机提醒。

words.enDefinition: the registrar's list of key deadlines for the term

examples.en: Bookmark the important dates page at the start of every term.
examples.zh: 每学期开始，把「重要日期」页面加个书签。

examples.en: Important dates include fee deadlines, reading week, and exam periods.
examples.zh: 「重要日期」包括缴费截止日、阅读周和考试周。

words.enDefinition: the registrar's searchable listing of every section and time

examples.en: The schedule of classes updates nightly as seats fill and open.
examples.zh: 随着名额变动，「课程安排表」每晚都会更新。

examples.en: Filter the schedule of classes by campus before choosing sections.
examples.zh: 选课前，先按校区筛选「课程安排表」。

words.enDefinition: the forms and documents an office requires you to complete

examples.en: Bring all your paperwork in one folder to avoid a second trip.
examples.zh: 把所有「手续材料」装进一个文件夹，免得跑第二趟。

examples.en: The internship paperwork took longer than the job search itself.
examples.zh: 实习的「手续材料」比找工作本身还耗时。

words.enDefinition: the printed or online form used to apply for something

examples.en: Download the application form from the forms library on the portal.
examples.zh: 在系统的表格库里下载「申请表」。

examples.en: The application form asks for your student ID number and program.
examples.zh: 「申请表」要填学号和项目信息。

words.enDefinition: the act of handing in a completed official form

examples.en: You will get a confirmation email after each form submission.
examples.zh: 每次「表格提交」后都会收到确认邮件。

examples.en: A late form submission can delay your enrollment verification letter.
examples.zh: 「表格提交」过晚，你的在读证明信可能会延迟。

words.enDefinition: extra papers, like letters or records, attached to an application

examples.en: Attach supporting documents such as bank letters or medical notes.
examples.zh: 请附上银行证明或医疗记录等「佐证材料」。

examples.en: Your appeal is stronger with supporting documents from the professor.
examples.zh: 有教授出具的「佐证材料」，申诉会更有力。

words.enDefinition: official papers used to prove your case in an appeal

examples.en: Bring documentary evidence such as flight itineraries or hospital notes.
examples.zh: 带上行程单或医院记录等「书面证据」。

examples.en: The committee accepted her emails as documentary evidence of the outage.
examples.zh: 委员会接受她的邮件作为系统故障的「书面证据」。

words.enDefinition: how long an office needs to finish your request

examples.en: Processing time for transcripts is three to five business days.
examples.zh: 成绩单的「处理时间」为三至五个工作日。

examples.en: Ask about the processing time before you pay for express service.
examples.zh: 加急付费之前，先问清「处理时间」。

words.enDefinition: a small charge for handling a request or document

examples.en: Each extra transcript copy carries a five-dollar processing fee at the counter.
examples.zh: 在柜台加印成绩单，每份要收五美元「手续费」。

examples.en: The processing fee is waived for students with financial hardship.
examples.zh: 经济困难学生的「手续费」可以减免。

words.enDefinition: the code an office gives you to track your request

examples.en: Quote the reference number in every follow-up email you send.
examples.zh: 你发的每封后续邮件都要写上「受理编号」。

examples.en: The reference number appears on the receipt right after submission.
examples.zh: 提交后，收据上会立刻显示「受理编号」。

words.enDefinition: weekdays when offices are open, excluding weekends and holidays

examples.en: Allow five business days for the letter to arrive by mail.
examples.zh: 信件邮寄要留出五个「工作日」。

examples.en: The office answers requests within two business days, weekends excluded.
examples.zh: 办公室两个「工作日」内答复，周末不算。

words.enDefinition: an automatic message confirming that your request was received

examples.en: You will get a confirmation email after each form submission.
examples.zh: 每次提交表格后都会收到「确认邮件」。

examples.en: The confirmation email lists the office to contact if something is wrong.
examples.zh: 「确认邮件」里写明了出问题时该联系的部门。

words.enDefinition: a formal letter on university letterhead that other institutions accept

examples.en: Request an official letter if the embassy needs proof of enrollment.
examples.zh: 大使馆需要在读证明的话，就申请一份「正式公函」。

examples.en: The official letter arrived signed and stamped in the mail.
examples.zh: 签章齐全的「正式公函」寄到了。

words.enDefinition: a formal ask put in writing instead of spoken

examples.en: Submit a written request if the phone queue keeps failing you.
examples.zh: 电话一直打不通，就提交「书面申请」。

examples.en: Keep a copy of every written request for your own files.
examples.zh: 每份「书面申请」都自己留一份底。

words.enDefinition: as a document, not spoken or phoned

examples.en: Ask for every promise in writing before you pay anything.
examples.zh: 付款之前，任何承诺都要「落实在书面上」。

examples.en: The registrar confirmed my withdrawal in writing, which protected my refund.
examples.zh: 注册办以「书面形式」确认了退学，保住了我的退款。

words.enDefinition: the official letter stating the outcome of your request

examples.en: The decision letter arrived exactly ten days after the hearing.
examples.zh: 「决定通知信」在听证后第十天准时寄到。

examples.en: Download the decision letter from the portal under my documents.
examples.zh: 在系统的“我的文件”里下载「决定通知信」。

words.enDefinition: the official written outcome explaining what was approved or denied

examples.en: The written decision listed the reasons the petition was denied.
examples.zh: 「书面决定」列出了特批申请被拒的原因。

examples.en: Ask for a written decision so you can plan the next appeal step.
examples.zh: 索要「书面决定」，方便规划下一步申诉。

words.enDefinition: special permission to break a standard rule in one case

examples.en: Her late add was approved as a one-time policy exception.
examples.zh: 她的逾期加选作为一次性「破例批准」获得了通过。

examples.en: Most policy exceptions require a signature from the department chair.
examples.zh: 多数「破例批准」都需要系主任签字。

words.enDefinition: serious events beyond your control, like illness or bereavement

examples.en: Serious illness counts as extenuating circumstances for a late withdrawal.
examples.zh: 重病属于可申请逾期退课的「特殊情况」。

examples.en: Document your extenuating circumstances with official letters, not just descriptions.
examples.zh: 「特殊情况」要用官方信函佐证，不能只靠口头描述。

words.enDefinition: a formal ask for copies of documents from your file

examples.en: Submit a records request if your old school still holds transcripts.
examples.zh: 旧学校还扣着成绩单的话，就提交「档案调取申请」。

examples.en: Peak periods slow every records request by a few days.
examples.zh: 高峰期会拖慢每一份「档案调取申请」几天。

words.enDefinition: a signed form permitting the office to share your information

examples.en: Sign the release form so your parents can discuss your account.
examples.zh: 签了「信息公开授权表」，父母才能查询你的账户。

examples.en: Without a release form, staff cannot even confirm you are enrolled.
examples.zh: 没有「信息公开授权表」，工作人员连你是否在读都不能确认。

words.enDefinition: an official note printed on transcripts about discipline or awards

examples.en: A suspension can leave a transcript notation that employers may see.
examples.zh: 停学处分可能在成绩单上留下雇主能看到的「备注」。

examples.en: Dean's list semesters show up as a positive transcript notation.
examples.zh: 登上优秀生名单的学期会在成绩单上留下正面「备注」。

words.enDefinition: so you can keep a copy of a document

examples.en: Keep the stamped receipt for your records in case of disputes.
examples.zh: 请保留盖章收据「供你存档」，以备出现争议。

examples.en: The clerk printed a second copy of the form for your records.
examples.zh: 柜员多打印了一份表格，「供你存档」。

words.enDefinition: book a fixed meeting slot with an office or advisor

examples.en: Schedule an appointment online because walk-ins wait longest at noon.
examples.zh: 尽量在线「预约办理」，中午现场取号等得最久。

examples.en: Schedule an appointment with the registrar before the deadline rush.
examples.zh: 赶在截止日高峰之前向注册办「预约办理」。

words.enDefinition: move a booked meeting to a different time

examples.en: You can reschedule your appointment if it clashes with your exam.
examples.zh: 如果和考试冲突，你可以「改约时间」。

examples.en: Reschedule an appointment at least a day ahead to avoid a no-show mark.
examples.zh: 「改约时间」至少要提前一天，以免被记爽约。

words.enDefinition: a visit without an appointment, served when a slot frees up

examples.en: Walk-in visits are welcome on Tuesdays, but Wednesdays are appointment only.
examples.zh: 周二接受「无预约到访」，周三只办理预约。

examples.en: As a walk-in, I waited forty minutes behind booked students.
examples.zh: 作为「无预约到访」的人，我排在预约学生后面等了四十分钟。

words.enDefinition: the official guide to university rules, offices, and procedures

examples.en: The student handbook lists every deadline and each office contact.
examples.zh: 「学生手册」列出了所有截止日期和各部门联系方式。

examples.en: Search the student handbook before emailing a question to the registrar.
examples.zh: 给注册办提问之前，先查查「学生手册」。

words.enDefinition: a student studying in a country other than their own

examples.en: As an international student, keep your enrollment verification letter updated.
examples.zh: 作为「国际学生」，要保证在读证明信始终有效。

examples.en: International students should scan every official letter for their files.
examples.zh: 「国际学生」应把每封官方信函扫描留档。

words.enDefinition: officially cancel an acceptance, usually over failed conditions

examples.en: The university can rescind an offer if final grades collapse.
examples.zh: 期末成绩大跌的话，学校可能「撤回录取」。

examples.en: The school may rescind the offer once falsified grades are confirmed.
examples.zh: 一旦成绩造假被证实，学校可能「撤回录取」。

words.enDefinition: confirm that the original ruling stands after review

examples.en: The committee will uphold a decision if the original process was fair.
examples.zh: 如果原流程公正，委员会通常会「维持原决定」。

examples.en: If they uphold the decision, your last option is the ombudsperson.
examples.zh: 如果委员会「维持原决定」，你最后的途径是找申诉专员。

words.enDefinition: reverse an earlier ruling after reviewing new evidence

examples.en: The committee voted to overturn the decision after seeing her medical note.
examples.zh: 看到她的医疗证明后，委员会投票「推翻原决定」。

examples.en: A committee will rarely overturn a decision without fresh written evidence.
examples.zh: 没有新的书面证据，委员会很少会「推翻决定」。

words.enDefinition: the offices and officials that run the university day to day

examples.en: The university administration announced new fee deadline rules for spring.
examples.zh: 「校方行政部门」公布了春季缴费截止日期的新规定。

examples.en: Emails from university administration always end with an office contact.
examples.zh: 「校方行政部门」的邮件总会在末尾附上部门联系方式。

words.enDefinition: dropping a course after the official deadline, recorded as W or F

examples.en: A late withdrawal needs the dean's approval and a solid written reason.
examples.zh: 「逾期退课」需要院长批准和一条充分的书面理由。

examples.en: The late withdrawal shows as a W on my transcript, not an F.
examples.zh: 这次「逾期退课」在我的成绩单上记为 W，而不是 F。

words.enDefinition: the official form used to drop a course or leave the term

examples.en: Pick up a withdrawal form at the department office before Friday.
examples.zh: 周五前去系办公室领取「退课申请表」。

examples.en: Both the instructor and advisor must sign your withdrawal form.
examples.zh: 「退课申请表」需要任课教师和导师共同签字。

words.enDefinition: a policy letting a retaken course grade replace the old one

examples.en: Under grade replacement, the new calculus grade erases the old F.
examples.zh: 根据「成绩替换」政策，新的微积分成绩会覆盖原来的 F。

examples.en: Ask if grade replacement is limited to two courses in total.
examples.zh: 问问「成绩替换」是否总共只限两门课。

words.enDefinition: the printed heading with the university name and logo

examples.en: The letter must be on letterhead or the embassy will not accept it.
examples.zh: 信必须有「信头」，否则使馆不会受理。

examples.en: You can download a letterhead template from the office intranet.
examples.zh: 可以在办公室内网下载「信头」模板。

words.enDefinition: the embossed or inked stamp that makes a document official

examples.en: The certificate is not valid without the official seal in red ink.
examples.zh: 没有红色「公章」，证书无效。

examples.en: Check for the official seal before mailing any certified copy.
examples.zh: 寄出任何认证副本之前，先检查有没有盖「公章」。
